| **Sat** | Overnight oats (as Wed) | **Veggie hummus wrap + side salad** – wrap, mixed greens, tofu, roasted cauliflower, olive‑oil + yogurt cup | **Grain‑anchored bowl + chicken‑noodle soup** – quinoa, mixed greens, chickpeas, roasted potatoes, grilled chicken + soup | Roasted chickpeas + fruit |

**Key points of the plan**

* **Components‑first** – Every meal is built from the same small set of interchangeable components (protein, grain, veg, legume/fiber, healthy fats, extras) [[concepts/components]].  
* **Assembly meals** – Meals are assembled on the spot with minimal cooking using café‑style items (pre‑washes greens, rotisserie chicken, microwavable grains, canned beans, ready soups) [[concepts/assembly_meals]].  
* **Grab‑and‑go snacks** – Snacks are portable, protein‑rich, and require no prep [[summaries/session‑38_2025‑10‑16]].  

---

## Efficient Shopping List (one‑week supply)

| Category | Items (quantity for 7 days) | Notes |
|----------|----------------------------|-------|
| **Proteins** | Grilled chicken (≈ 1 kg) – can be bought rotisserie or pre‑cooked; Tofu (2 blocks); Turkey sliced deli meat (≈ 300 g); Hard‑boiled eggs (≈ 12) | Choose the protein that matches each day’s combo. |
| **Grains / Starches** | Microwavable brown‑rice cups (7 × 1 cup) or quinoa cups (5 × 1 cup); Whole‑grain sandwich bread (1 loaf) | Use whichever is offered at the café; both fit the “grain” component. |
| **Veggies** | Mixed greens (≈ 2 large bags); Spinach (optional for variety); Pre‑washed carrot sticks; Bell peppers (2); Cherry tomatoes (1 pint); Roasted broccoli/cauliflower (pre‑roasted trays, 2) | Greens are the base for every salad/bowl. |
| **Legumes / Fiber** | Canned chickpeas (3 cans); Black beans (2 cans); Lentil soup (7 cups, either canned or café‑made) | Provide the fiber‑rich “legume” slot. |
| **Healthy Fats** | Avocados (4 units); Feta cheese (200 g) or shredded cheddar (150 g); Olive‑oil spray or small bottle (≈ 250 ml); Mixed nuts (200 g) | Add to salads, bowls, or snacks. |
| **Extras / Flavor** | Light vinaigrette dressing (bottle) or lemon‑herb spray; Hummus (1 large tub) | Used in wraps & salads. |
| **Dairy / Snack Bases** | Yogurt cups (14 × single‑serve) ; Cheese sticks (7 × one) | Breakfast & snack protein boost. |
| **Fruit** | Bananas (7); Apples (7); Berries (fresh or frozen, 1 cup) | Pair with yogurt, nut‑butter, or granola bars. |
| **Packaged Snacks** | Granola bars (14) ; Single‑serve nut‑butter packets (7) ; Roasted chickpeas (store‑bought, 3 packs) | Quick “bag‑ready” options [[summaries/session‑38_2025‑10‑16]]. |
| **Soup** | Lentil soup (3 cups), Vegetable soup (2 cups), Chili (2 cups), Chicken‑noodle soup (2 cups) – can be bought canned or ordered from the café each day | One cup per lunch or dinner combo. |

**Shopping‑time tips (from the cheat‑sheet)**  

1. **Batch‑buy core components** – Get enough chicken, tofu, and roasted veggies to reuse across several meals, reducing trips to the café or grocery store.  
2. **Pre‑portion snacks** – Divide nuts, cheese sticks, and roasted chickpeas into single‑serve bags when you get home; they’re ready to grab the next day.  
3. **Use the “visible go‑to” rule** – Keep the staples (greens, protein, grain cups) front‑and‑center in the fridge/pantry so you automatically assemble the day’s combo without decision‑fatigue.  

---

### How this plan stays smooth

* **Predictable component list** → only ~10 distinct items to shop for the whole week.  
* **Minimal cooking** → most meals are assembled from ready‑to‑eat café items; heating only soups or microwavable grains.  
* **Balanced nutrition** → each main meal includes a protein, a fiber source (legume or veg), a whole‑grain/starch, and a healthy fat, matching the balance guidelines in the source material [[summaries/session‑38_2025‑10‑16]].  
* **Flexibility** → if a component is unavailable on a given day (e.g., no quinoa), swap another grain or increase the legume portion—still meets the “components” principle [[concepts/components]].

Feel free to rotate the three default combo patterns (Hearty salad + soup, Sandwich/wrap + soup, Grain‑anchored bowl + soup) throughout the week to keep variety while keeping the shopping list tiny and the prep time under 15 minutes per meal.
